name: claude-code-streamdeck
description: Stream Deck plugin for Claude Code: approve/deny, usage tile, slash-command keys

scripts.build: npm run gen:icons && esbuild src/plugin.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=com.siming.claude-code.sdPlugin/bin/plugin.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.watch: esbuild src/plugin.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=com.siming.claude-code.sdPlugin/bin/plugin.js --watch --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
